Between your top two gift ideas, which feels more special?
The ULTRA K9 stands out as our most special and premium gift option. It is our professional-grade flagship system with an IP65 fully waterproof remote, 1,100-yard range, night-light mode, and supports dogs from 8 to 150 lbs. It also comes complete with both standard and long contact prongs, making it a versatile and impressive gift for any dog owner.
By comparison, the SPARK K9 is a fantastic, reliable option that fits dogs up to 110 lbs and features a specialized bungee strap for long or thick fur, though its remote is not fully waterproof.
By the way, our 100% natural grass-fed beef bully sticks make a great high-value reward to add as a gift treat!
